label: target-postgres-path-repair
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=<WORKDIR>/E4/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -i <WORKDIR>/E4/id_ed25519 -p 22145 root@127.0.0.1 bash -s
script:
set -ux
systemctl stop postgresql@15-main
tar -xpf /root/e4/supplements.tar -C /root/e4/supplement-staging srv/e4-external
mkdir -p /srv/e4-relocated
mv /root/e4/supplement-staging/srv/e4-external/ts /srv/e4-relocated/ts
find /srv/e4-relocated/ts -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n'
systemctl start postgresql@15-main
runuser -u postgres -- psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d e4 -c 'TABLE external_state;'
echo BYTES_PRESENT_WRONG_PATH_RC=$?
systemctl stop postgresql@15-main
ln -sfn /srv/e4-relocated/ts /var/lib/postgresql/15/main/pg_tblspc/16384
chown -h postgres:postgres /var/lib/postgresql/15/main/pg_tblspc/16384
systemctl start postgresql@15-main
runuser -u postgres -- psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d e4 -c 'TABLE state; TABLE external_state;'
echo REBOUND_TABLESPACE_RC=$?
readlink /var/lib/postgresql/15/main/pg_tblspc/16384
